description: Terminal-verdict ledger rows whose audit_state_snapshot predates the runner-pin fields and therefore leaves at least one declared runner-source channel unbound. An entry recording runner_path/runner_sha256_at_baseline has the primary channel unbound; an entry recording helper_runner_sha256_at_baseline has the helper channel unbound; most rows are unbound on one channel and still pinned on the other, so this is not a list of rows binding no runner content at all. Recorded once, shrink-only: audit_lint reports any terminal row outside this list (error on a retained-grade row, warning otherwise), errors on a retained-grade row whose recorded runner content moves away from the sha recorded here or whose unbound helper closure grows, and notices every entry that has drained. Entries are never added by tooling. The recorded shas assert repository content at baseline time, never what an auditor saw; audit_status and effective_status are non-authoritative copies of the ledger row as of that moment, are not read by any classification path, and never carry or propose a verdict.
